title: Tiny but Trusted: Efficient Vision-Language Reasoning for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.30344v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in Vision--Language Models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across many tasks, yet prior studies report unsatisfactory performance when applying large language or multimodal models to finding abnormal patterns in sequential data. Public anomaly detection benchmarks typically provide interval annotations but not natural-language rationales, making it difficult to fine-tune VLMs to produce grounded, interpretable decisions. To address this gap, we construct VisAnomBench, a curated benchmark built from public time-series datasets and augmented with high-quality anomaly explanations selected from multiple large VLMs using fine-grained, task-specific rewards. Through fine-tuning on this benchmark, we develop VisAnomReasoner, a parameter-efficient VLM for time-series anomaly detection. translated_title: 小而可信：面向时间序列异常检测的高效视觉-语言推理
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的最新进展在众多任务上取得了令人瞩目的表现，然而先前的研究表明，将大型语言模型或多模态模型应用于发现序列数据中的异常模式时，其表现并不理想。公开的异常检测基准通常只提供区间标注而缺乏自然语言的理由说明，这使得难以对VLM进行微调以产生有依据、可解释的决策。为填补这一空白，我们构建了VisAnomBench——一个基于公开时间序列数据集精心构建的基准，并通过使用细粒度、任务特定的奖励机制从多个大型VLM中筛选出的高质量异常解释对其进行增强。通过在该基准上进行微调，我们开发了VisAnomReasoner，一个用于时间序列异常检测的参数高效VLM。在VisAnomBench上的结果表明，VisAnomReasoner实现了更准确的异常定位，并持续优于所有基线方法。
tldr: 提出高质量异常解释增强的基准VisAnomBench和参数高效的视觉-语言模型VisAnomReasoner，实现了更准确、可解释的时间序列异常检测。
en_tdlr: Proposes VisAnomBench, a benchmark augmented with high-quality anomaly explanations, and VisAnomReasoner, a parameter-efficient VLM achieving more accurate and interpretable time-series anomaly detection.
